video_title: Windy says Boston felt Derrick White had a better season than Jaylen Brown 😬

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics believed Derrick White had a better season than Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics felt that even though Jaylen Brown was talking about himself for MVP, the Celtics did not feel that Jaylen had the best season on their team.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I just know that the Celtics felt that even though Jaylen Brown was talking about himself for MVP or there was this MVP campaign for Jaylen Brown, the Celtics did not feel that Jaylen had the best season on their team. And I don't mean Jason Tatum. I'm talking about they felt that Derrick White had a better season.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Despite the fact he had a poor shooting season. I agree. But they felt he impacted winning the most.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jaylen Brown trade was made under duress
quotes.excerpt: this was a trade that was made under duress. That this was not a trade that you would make in a clinical setting.
quotes.quote: My phone blew up and what people are saying to me, Bobby, and this is the league speculation, it's not reporting, but I don't dispute it, is that this was a trade that was made under duress. That this was not a trade that you would make in a clinical setting. There's no deadline. You didn't have to do it by the end of July 1st, that you wouldn't do this trade under these circumstances if everything was equal, that something wasn't equal.
